text: [138] pañcahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca laṇḍusādhano 1 ca salākaggāhī ca rañño nāgotevava saṅkhaṃ gacchati katamehi pañcahi idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ akkhamo saddānaṃ akkhamo gandhānaṃ akkhamo rasānaṃ akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca laṇḍusādhano ca salākaggāhī ca rañño nāgotevava saṅkhaṃ gacchati evameva kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca pīṭhamaddano 2 ca salākaggāhī ca bhikkhutevava saṅkhaṃ gacchati katamehi pañcahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ akkhamo saddānaṃ akkhamo gandhānaṃ akkhamo rasānaṃ akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato #1 po. paṇḍusādano . ma. laṇḍasāraṇo . yu. laṇḍasādhano . 2 ma. mañcapīṭhamaddano . bhikkhu bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca pīṭhamaddano 1 ca salākaggāhī ca bhikkhutevava saṅkhaṃ gacchatīti .
